cues.en: Before we start diving into code and algorithms, let's talk a little bit about recommender systems at a high level.
cues.zh: 在深入程式碼與演算法之前，先從整體角度談談推薦系統。

cues.en: You encounter them every day and might not even think about it.
cues.zh: 你每天都會接觸到它們，可能卻從來沒特別注意。

cues.en: They can take many different forms and serve many different purposes.
cues.zh: 它們有許多不同形式，也服務不同目的。

cues.en: My own claim to fame is recommending things.
cues.zh: 我自己的專長，就是推薦東西。

cues.en: I worked on Amazon's early recommender systems, which look at your past purchasing behavior to recommend other products you might like.
cues.zh: 我曾參與 Amazon 早期推薦系統的開發，根據你過去的購買行為，推薦其他可能喜歡的商品。

cues.en: For example, I recently bought a gas-powered generator and Amazon is automatically recommending things like starter fluid and motor oil to me.
cues.zh: 例如，我最近買了一台汽油發電機，Amazon 就自動推薦啟動液、機油等東西給我。

cues.en: You'd be amazed how effective these recommendations can be.
cues.zh: 這些推薦的成效，可能會讓你驚訝。

cues.en: Billions of dollars have resulted from them and they've helped people find the things that they need.
cues.zh: 它們帶來數十億美元的收益，也幫助人們找到需要的東西。

cues.en: The beauty of it is that it's all data-driven.
cues.zh: 美妙之處在於，一切都由資料驅動。

cues.en: Recommender systems find relationships between users and between items just based on actions.
cues.zh: 推薦系統只根據行為，就找出使用者之間、項目之間的關係。

cues.en: Usually, there's no human curation involved, at all.
cues.zh: 通常完全不需要人工挑選。

cues.en: It knows that statistically, people who buy generators also buy starter fluid, and it can use those historical patterns to show people stuff they want before they even know they want it.
cues.zh: 它知道統計上購買發電機的人也會買啟動液，利用這些歷史模式，在人們還不知道自己需要之前，就展示他們想要的東西。

cues.en: But you don't have to limit yourself to recommending things.
cues.zh: 不過，你不必只推薦物品。

cues.en: You can also recommend content.
cues.zh: 也可以推薦內容。

cues.en: Here's a recommender system used by the New York Times, which is a popular newspaper in the US.
cues.zh: 這是美國知名報紙《紐約時報》使用的推薦系統。

cues.en: It looks at articles you've read in the past to recommend other articles you might enjoy reading.
cues.zh: 它會根據你過去讀過的文章，推薦你可能喜歡閱讀的其他文章。

cues.en: Same idea, just looking at patterns in the articles people read, instead of patterns in the stuff people buy.
cues.zh: 概念相同，只是觀察人們閱讀文章的模式，而不是購買物品的模式。

cues.en: Music recommendations is its own special case.
cues.zh: 音樂推薦則是一個特殊案例。

cues.en: Sure, you can treat it just like any other content and recommend music that other people have listened to who share your tastes but services like Pandora take it a step further,
cues.zh: 當然，你也可以把它當成其他內容，推薦品味相近的人聽過的音樂；但 Pandora 等服務更進一步，

cues.en: and analyze the waveforms of the music, itself, to find similarities between tempos, musical styles, and song structures.
cues.zh: 分析音樂本身的波形，找出節奏、曲風與歌曲結構的相似之處。

cues.en: This is an example of content-based recommendations, where your recommendations aren't just based on user behavior but on the properties of the things you're recommending, themselves.
cues.zh: 這是內容式推薦的例子，推薦不只根據使用者行為，也根據被推薦項目本身的特性。

cues.en: In this case, the musical properties of the songs you like.
cues.zh: 這裡指的就是你喜歡的歌曲所具備的音樂特性。

cues.en: Look up Pandora's Music Genome Project if you're interested in more depth on that.
cues.zh: 如果有興趣深入了解，可以查查 Pandora 的 Music Genome Project。

cues.en: Why stop at products, content, and music?
cues.zh: 為什麼只限於商品、內容與音樂呢？

cues.en: You can even recommend people.
cues.zh: 甚至可以推薦人。

cues.en: That's basically what online dating websites do.
cues.zh: 網路交友網站基本上就在做這件事。

cues.en: They are recommender systems, as well.
cues.zh: 它們也是推薦系統。

cues.en: As a married man, though, it's not really my area of expertise.
cues.zh: 不過身為已婚男士，這並不是我的專長。

cues.en: There's even a fine line between search engines and recommender systems.
cues.zh: 搜尋引擎與推薦系統之間，甚至也只有一線之隔。

cues.en: Modern search results tend to be personalized.
cues.zh: 現代搜尋結果通常會個人化。

cues.en: It's not just doing information retrieval, it's looking at your past behavior as an individual to figure out what search results are most relevant to you.
cues.zh: 它不只是資訊檢索，還會根據你個人過去的行為，判斷哪些搜尋結果與你最相關。

cues.en: Think of it as recommending web pages, just like you would recommend books, music, or newspaper articles.
cues.zh: 你可以把它想成推薦網頁，就像推薦書籍、音樂或報紙文章一樣。

cues.en: In this example, I typed in the name of my favorite sushi restaurant and although that name means many different things to many different people, Google knows where I live, where I've been,
cues.zh: 在這個例子中，我輸入最喜歡的壽司店名稱。儘管這個名字對不同人可能有許多不同含義，Google 知道我住哪裡、去過哪裡，

cues.en: and the websites that I've visited in the past, and it can use all that information to pull up results about the restaurant down the street from me, instead of pages about yuki hana's Japanese translation of snow flower.
cues.zh: 以及過去造訪過的網站，能利用這些資訊，找出我家附近那間餐廳的結果，而不是介紹 Yuki Hana 在日語中是「雪花」的網頁。

cues.en: So, you see, recommender systems are everywhere and they are responsible for a huge portion of the modern economy.
cues.zh: 所以你看，推薦系統無所不在，也促成現代經濟中相當龐大的一部分。

cues.en: It's not something you hear about often but people who know how to build them are in very high demand because recommender systems can have a direct influence on a company's sales.
cues.zh: 雖然平常不常聽到，但能建立推薦系統的人才需求很高，因為推薦系統能直接影響公司的銷售額。

cues.en: Whether you're trying to recommend things, articles, music, movies, people, or webpages, recommender systems are the technology behind it.
cues.zh: 無論推薦物品、文章、音樂、電影、人物或網頁，背後的技術都是推薦系統。
